title: Man and Van Birmingham & West Midlands
metaTitle: Man and Van Birmingham | Transparent Hourly Rates | Jimmys Removals
metaDescription: Reliable, insured man and van service in Birmingham and the West Midlands. Clean Air Zone compliant Luton vans with 1, 2, or 3 men. Transparent hourly or fixed rates.
heroHeading: Professional Man & Van Services Across the West Midlands
heroSubheading: Flexible hourly or fixed rates for small home moves, single large items, student transfers, and local deliveries with insured removal staff.
summary: Need a flexible, fast removal solution without the overhead of a multi-day operation? Our Man and Van service pairs modern, clean Luton vans with courteous, heavy-lifting professionals. Whether moving a studio flat or picking up marketplace purchases, we deliver professional care.
benefits: Clean Air Zone compliant vans — no clean air charges added
Fully insured with Goods in Transit and Public Liability protection
Equipped with transit ties, protective blankets, and sack barrows
7-day availability with evening and weekend time slots

process.title: Select Crew & Duration
process.description: Choose between our flexible hourly rate with a clear minimum booking or a pre-agreed fixed quotation for defined loads.

process.title: Punctual Van Arrival
process.description: Our driver and crew arrive punctually at your address, inspect the items to be moved, and plan the vehicle load order.

process.title: Careful Van Loading
process.description: Possessions are loaded, cushioned with protective blankets, and secured using heavy-duty lashing points inside the van.

process.title: Prompt Delivery & Unload
process.description: We drive directly to your drop-off location, unload items to your specified rooms, and confirm everything has arrived in pristine order.

whatsIncluded: Clean, spacious 3.5-tonne Luton van with tail lift
Professional driver plus optional 1 or 2 porters
Fuel for agreed local mileage within the West Midlands
Loading, securing, transport, and unloading assistance
Goods in transit and public liability cover
whatsNotIncluded: Disposal of hazardous building rubble or commercial trade waste
Toll charges (e.g. M6 Toll if requested by customer)
Fines arising from lack of customer-provided parking permits
priceNotes: Achievable rate for 1 man and Luton van with a 2-hour minimum booking within central Birmingham and surrounding districts.

faqs.question: What is the minimum booking time for the man and van service?
faqs.answer: Our minimum booking period is 2 hours. After the initial 2 hours, time is billed in clear 30-minute increments, so you only pay for what you actually use.

faqs.question: Can I travel in the van cab with the driver?
faqs.answer: Subject to seatbelt availability and advance notice, one passenger may accompany the driver in the cab between collection and delivery addresses.

faqs.question: Are your vans compliant with Birmingham's Clean Air Zone?
faqs.answer: Yes, our vehicles meet Euro 6 standards, allowing free travel within the Birmingham A4540 Middleway without incurring CAZ fees.

faqs.question: Can your team help with heavy items like American fridge-freezers?
faqs.answer: Yes. When you book a 2-man or 3-man crew, we use heavy-duty sack barrows and moving straps to safely manoeuvre bulky appliances.
